Amir (Partner PM): Quick sync: RetailEdge wants a joint co-sell POC. Requirements: EU-FR residency, SAML+SCIM, reseller monthly commit, and low egress for nightly embeddings exports. Any immediate blockers?

Sora (SE): Need qps and average tokens. If interactive latency target is <250ms we should use Dedicated in fr-par. Bulk embeddings should be staged to an S3 bucket in the same region to avoid cross-region egress.

Marco (Partner AE): RetailEdge numbers: peak 22 qps, ~1k tokens avg, nightly embeddings ~5M rows. They asked for a 12-month OEM-style commit with partner billing.

Ravi (NetOps): For connectivity options: VPC Peering (requires non-overlapping CIDRs), AWS PrivateLink, or partner-initiated mirror via same-region S3. PrivateLink reduces NAT egress; peering needs routing updates. Will compute egress estimate for 5M vectors.

Elena (Security): They requested ISO27001 evidence and an encryption-at-rest + HSM note. HSM keys only on Private deployments; Dedicated can use customer-managed KMS for some tiers. Also need completed security questionnaire prior to kickoff: https://redwood.example.com/security/questionnaire

Sora (SE): POC plan: chat on Dedicated in fr-par, prefix caching for common flows, nightly job reading partner S3 and writing outputs back to partner S3. Small sample runbook to demo.

Ravi (NetOps): Rough egress calc: assuming compressed int8 vectors, 5M rows ~20GB outbound; float32 ~150GB. I'll post detailed numbers and PrivateLink cost delta by EOD.

Marco (Partner AE): I'll upload a draft reseller term sheet and confirm whether partner wants partner-facing telemetry dashboard or daily CSV.

Amir (Partner PM): Action list: @Sora runbook + perf targets, @Ravi egress/connectivity cost, @Elena curated security pack, @Marco term sheet. ops-bot create intake ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket created: SR-5433 "RetailEdge co-sell POC: netops/security/licensing" https://support.redwood.example.com/SR-5433

Elena (Security): One more thing: if they want log retention >90 days that will require compliance add-on; flag that in the call.

Sora (SE): I'll include canary config with `--continuous-batching=adaptive --kv-cache=on --quantize=int8` and expected latencies.

Amir (Partner PM): Thanks team. If Marco can get IdP metadata and CSV schema before kickoff we can demo SAML+SCIM and nightly embed flow. :thumbsup:
